neighbours.label: later word pieces inside ALL-CAPS words (GOVER|NMENT, DENT|AL)
fire: The sign outside read DENTAL CLINIC OPEN TODAY.
Please print your name in the box marked SIGNATURE REQUIRED.
The banner said WELCOME TO THE ANNUAL CONFERENCE.
He shouted CONGRATULATIONS across the crowded hall.
The letter was stamped CONFIDENTIAL GOVERNMENT DOCUMENT.
The headline screamed EARTHQUAKE DEVASTATES COASTAL TOWNS.
Each box was labeled FRAGILE EQUIPMENT HANDLE CAREFULLY.
The poster announced CHAMPIONSHIP TOURNAMENT TONIGHT.
quiet: The sign outside read dental clinic open today.
Please print your name in the box marked signature required.
The banner said welcome to the annual conference.
He shouted congratulations across the crowded hall.

notes: Top examples: D|ENT|AL, GO|VERN|MENT, C|OURSE, NUM|PY, McCA|IN. Peak tokens are all mid-word pieces of uppercase words. The + pole already holds a similar label. Not probed. Near misses use the same words in lowercase.
